matchDriver.title: Match the driver again
matchDriver.description: Looks up which booking had the car at the time of the offence, after the car or time was corrected.

chargeCustomer.title: Charge the customer
chargeCustomer.description: Adds the fine and the handling fee to booking {booking} of {driver} and emails them. A saved card is charged now.

nominateDriver.title: Name the driver
nominateDriver.description: Send the driver letter for {driver} to the authority; they pay the fine. The handling fee, if set, is charged to booking {booking}.

dispute.title: Dispute the fine
dispute.description: Nothing is charged or reminded while it is contested. Match the driver again if the dispute is lost.

annul.title: Annul the fine
annul.description: The authority dropped the fine. Anything charged to booking {booking} for it is taken back: credited on its invoice and refunded if paid.
